content_of_post_to_comment:
Hello, guys. I hope you are well.

My mind is constantly plagued by this extreme fear that I am too stupid to achieve anything in life, no matter how hard I try. I have autism and 40% of autists have an intellectual disability, and I genuinely think I am one of them. Everywhere I go, people call me stupid, I genuinely don‘t know why they won‘t just leave me alone. I‘ve been crying for days because I am too stupid for this world. At a university I passed four engineering math exams with top grades, and it came to me easily. Is there any correlation between IQ and mathematical ability? According to a study, a man with mild intellectual disability has the math skills of a 12 year old child, but my own skills far exceed that, I can even crush difficult engineering math exams. Also I wrote this text in English as a German, and it is written rather well, right? Am I stupid? How can I be sure I am not stupid, what should I do? Please help me, guys. I cry every day out of sheer frustration. What career should I choose………?
comment: Passing four engineering math exams with top grades and finding them easy is not evidence of intellectual disability. Also, IQ is not a perfect measure of a person's ability or potential. It sounds like the bigger problem is that people calling you stupid has started to feel like proof, even though your own achievements contradict it. Have you considered that you may be judging yourself by the harshest voices around you?
